scope: Frozen focused-initial verification policy on12 fresh public exercise families with registered source mutations; separate held-out repair validation, not long-horizon memory or official benchmark evidence.
source: Same pinned MIT Exercism commit479f11b44b02337b0413e805b948491c2179615a, selected12 families before instruction/test/reference reads. A dated complete selected-source/stdlib and current advisory review plus own controls is required before execution.
controls: Each selected family requires its own empty, reference and one seeded-bug control. One small deterministic semantic mutation, selected from a predeclared arithmetic/boundary/predicate/scoring category after source review and before models, recorded with hashes. No model-outcome selection, retries or replacement. If a safe single mutation or valid independent control is unavailable, mark excluded before inference without replacement and report incomplete allocation.
matching: Use identical generation prompts and native profile from development001; only study paths/port/task allocation change. Both arms get same mutated source, visible tests and instructions. Full final verification common. Current user/research instructions excluded for experimental actors only. Host grades after all generation; no cross-arm solutions/evaluator feedback.
ordering: Fixed task order; rotate two arm order by task index; sequential inference, no other subject worker. Host grading after all generation, no favorable stopping.
application: Record actual native test/edit command order. Characterize whether initial checks follow assigned arm and final full suite occurs; assignment is primary intention-to-treat even if nonadherent. Do not call prompt compliance a quality result.
primary: Frozen joint gate: retain every matched full-initial success, >=10% lower pooled published-rate inference cost, and >half of paired task cost wins. Require complete registered allocation and reconciled usage; otherwise incomplete/inconclusive. Report every assignment, failed process and quality loss.12 pairs cannot establish narrow population noninferiority; provide uncertainty and no-observed-loss wording.
grading: Independent fresh original unittest suite plus only candidate implementation and protected-file policy; controls/expected test counts sealed before model calls. Original tests are visible, so successful checks do not prove equal general code quality.
failure: Stop on process failure/timeout/ambiguous completion/source change/missing counters. Preserve every started or uncertain call, zero automatic retries, no replacement. A wrong solution does not stop remaining cells.
cost: Price each unique native response using frozen fresh/cached/output scenario, including recovery; subscription cash/quota and local operational prices remain unknown. Fewer tokens alone never a win.
overhead: All24 subject invocations plus source/security/analysis and metering work are research expense. No first-use net saving, cash or quota claim.
rollback: Owned validation proxy8334/worker only; no global settings or research schedules changed.
selection_rule: Nominate frozen focused-initial guidance from development001: all3 matched task successes retained,28.6063% lower pooled scenario cost and3/3 pair cost wins. Freeze exact common/arm prompts before reading validation source; no further prompt or policy tuning from validation outcomes.
